chunks: And indeed, Lot was one of the apostles.
ai.seo_question: Was Prophet Lot considered one of the messengers in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah As-Saffat underscores Lot’s (AS) distinct role as a messenger specifically sent to the people of Sodom, highlighting his perseverance amidst moral corruption. It reinforces the continuity of divine guidance through the lineage of prophets, linking his mission to the broader Abrahamic narrative of monotheism and justice.
